title: Network Service Issues

header.html: 5.3 Given a scenario, troubleshoot common issues with network services: switching issues (STP: network loops, root bridge selection, port roles, port states; incorrect VLAN assignment; ACLs); route selection (routing table, default routes); address pool exhaustion; incorrect default gateway; incorrect IP address and duplicate IP address; incorrect subnet mask
the official CompTIA Network+ N10-009 exam objectives, version 4.0

html:
1Switching issues

Issue Symptoms and fix
STP network loop Broadcast storm, very high CPU, MAC table flapping, network crawls; check STP, find the missing or misconfigured blocking port or an unmanaged switch loop
Wrong root bridge A small access switch becomes root, so traffic takes inefficient paths; set the intended core switch with the lowest priority
Port roles and states Check which ports are root, designated, blocked; a port stuck in blocking or listening during convergence explains no traffic
Incorrect VLAN assignment A host in the wrong VLAN cannot reach its gateway or peers; check the access port's VLAN
ACL blocking Traffic denied by a rule or the implicit deny; review ACL order and direction

2Routing issues

Issue Meaning
Routing table Check whether a route to the destination exists (show route) and which is selected
Default route missing or wrong Traffic to unknown networks (the internet) has nowhere to go
Route selection A more specific or lower-AD route may be sending traffic the wrong way

3Addressing issues

Issue Symptoms
Address pool exhaustion New clients get no address (or APIPA 169.254.x.x); scope full: shorten lease time, enlarge the scope, remove stale leases
Incorrect default gateway Local access works, nothing off the subnet works
Incorrect IP address Wrong subnet, so the host cannot reach its gateway
Duplicate IP address Intermittent connectivity for two hosts, "address conflict" warnings; find the duplicate with ARP, use DHCP reservations
Incorrect subnet mask Host cannot reach some local addresses, or thinks remote hosts are local
Exam tip

. Can reach local hosts but not the internet: check the default gateway. Intermittent connection for two hosts: duplicate IP address. 169.254.x.x: no DHCP or pool exhausted.

4A fast triage

Test If it fails, suspect
Ping 127.0.0.1 TCP/IP stack on the host
Ping own IP NIC or address configuration
Ping the default gateway Local link, VLAN, mask, gateway address
Ping a remote IP Routing, ACL, NAT
Ping a name DNS
Exam tip

. Local works but remote fails: gateway. 169.254.x.x: DHCP. Intermittent for two hosts: duplicate IP. Storm and MAC flapping: loop.

Exam tip

. Test from the bottom up: link, address and gateway, then routing, then DNS. The first failing step names the layer.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A network slows to a crawl, switch CPUs spike, and MAC addresses flap between ports. What is the likely cause?

  • AA DNS misconfiguration
  • BAn expired certificate
  • CA switching loop with spanning tree not blocking redundant paths
  • DA rogue DHCP server
Show the answer

Answer: C. Loops cause broadcast storms and MAC table flapping.

S2New laptops receive 169.254.x.x addresses while older devices work. What is the most likely cause?

  • AThe default gateway is wrong
  • BSpanning tree blocked the uplink
  • CThe DNS record is missing
  • DThe DHCP scope is exhausted
Show the answer

Answer: D. A full scope leaves new clients without leases.

S3A host can reach other devices on its subnet but nothing beyond. What should be checked first?

  • AThe DNS suffix
  • BThe MTU on the NIC
  • CThe default gateway setting
  • DThe host's MAC address
Show the answer

Answer: C. An incorrect default gateway blocks off-subnet traffic.

S4Two workstations lose connectivity intermittently and each shows an IP address conflict message. What is the cause?

  • AA duplicate IP address
  • BA wrong subnet mask
  • CA missing default route
  • DAn STP blocking port
Show the answer

Answer: A. Duplicate IPs cause conflicts and intermittent access.

S5After a switch replacement a user in the Finance VLAN cannot reach the Finance gateway. The port is up. What should be checked?

  • AThe cable category
  • BThe access port's VLAN assignment
  • CThe NTP server
  • DThe SNMP community string
Show the answer

Answer: B. A wrong VLAN on the access port isolates the host.

S6Internet traffic fails while internal traffic works, and the router has no route for 0.0.0.0/0. What should be added?

  • AA DHCP exclusion
  • BA native VLAN
  • CA jumbo frame setting
  • DA default route
Show the answer

Answer: D. Without a default route, unknown destinations are unreachable.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What does 169.254.x.x indicate?

Show the answer

The host could not get a DHCP address (APIPA).

R2What symptom does a duplicate IP address cause?

Show the answer

Intermittent connectivity and address conflict messages.

R3What happens when an incorrect default gateway is set?

Show the answer

Local traffic works but off-subnet traffic fails.

R4What does STP prevent?

Show the answer

Layer 2 loops.

R5What command shows the routing table?

Show the answer

show route (ip route or route print on hosts).

R6What does pinging the gateway test?

Show the answer

The local link, VLAN, mask and gateway configuration.
